category_title: Middle school student with cerebral palsy and orthopedic impairment exhibiting self-injurious behavior and verbal outbursts
scenario_title: General education reading and questioning activity
minimal_context: Jason is sitting in a general education classroom with an unfamiliar tutor to read an article about the culture of Japan and identify letters.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to read this article about the culture of Japan today. Can you look at the page and identify the first letter for me?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns his head away, refusing to talk or interact with the unfamiliar tutor.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the article. What letter is this right here?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues refusing to talk and begins engaging in self-stimulation, flapping his hands and rocking his body.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to try to answer. Just point to the letter on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Lets out a loud verbal outburst and begins engaging in self-injurious behavior, hitting himself and picking at his skin.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are going to read this article about the culture of Japan today. Can you look at the page and identify the first letter for me?

TUTOR: You need to try to answer. Just point to the letter on the paper.

STUDENT: (Lets out a loud verbal outburst and begins engaging in self-injurious behavior, hitting himself and picking at his skin.)

task.content: Reading an article about the culture of Japan and identifying letters by responding to questions
task.learning_goal: Demonstration of general education content acquisition

context.materials: Age-appropriate and grade-level materials (e.g., an article about the culture of Japan)
context.social_setting: General education classmates and teachers, with one-on-one assistance through a peer support program

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When approached by people who were unfamiliar to him
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Refusing to talk or interact with others, loud verbal outbursts, self-injurious behavior (hitting oneself, picking skin), and self-stimulation (hand flapping, body rocking)
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Associated only with people who were in his inner circle
related_quotes: associated only with people who were in his “inner circle,” refusing to talk or interact with others

behavior_patterns.condition: When provided with unrelated activities that had been prepared by special educators
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Curtailed interaction with classmates and lack of participation in class activities
